resources.string: What will your life look like if you turn around now?
What will your life look like if you start drinking again?
Write a few honest words — the morning, the people, how you want to feel…
Be honest with yourself — what tends to follow if you drink again…
Putting it into your own words matters. Hold onto what you just wrote — it’s a clear reminder of the life you’re choosing. You’re doing the work.

Reaching out was brave — even if they couldn’t pick up. Don’t worry that they weren’t available right now. You made the right decision stopping and trying. Let’s take a few quiet moments to ground yourself.
That’s exactly what this moment called for. Take a breath — you’re not alone in this. Head home when you’re ready.
Take your time — Continue when you’ve written something.
You opened the dialer for %1$s. Tell us what happened — we’ll meet you where you are.
If you’re not sure, choose “They didn’t answer” — we’ll still celebrate that you tried.
